name: prefetch_mam
description: Read a Windows Prefetch file, MAM-compressed (MAM\x04) or plain (SCCA), field by field by the layout of its SCCA version (17, 23, 26, 30 and 31; version 31 is read with version 30's layout, an assumption said in the answer; any other version is reported unsupported and no version-dependent field is interpreted): executable name, hash, run count, last-run FILETIMEs (raw decimal and ISO 8601 UTC with seven fractional digits), the filename strings section as the header locates it (every string whole, non-ASCII included), and the first volume entry (device path, serial, creation time); the file metrics, trace chains and later volume entries are located and counted, not decoded. MAM framing is checked before inflating: the method byte must be 4 (any other, a checksum-bearing variant included, is refused by name) and the declared size at most 64 MiB; the decompressor, dissect.util's, has no output bound of its own, so it is run with one (the declared size plus 64 KiB), past which the run fails, and a stream that ends short fails too. The decoder is the one mam_scan uses, so the two tools do not check each other. A Prefetch file does not say who ran a program, that it finished, or where it was started from.

path.description: Path to a Prefetch file, compressed (MAM) or plain SCCA
